acceptanceCriteria: opencode delivery is implemented or its UNSUPPORTED status stays explicit with a recorded reason
A threshold crossing with no subsequent tool call is delivered or reported as undelivered
Candidate hand-offs and retention behaviour for notes are specified and tested
body: Residuals of V1-1763 (PR #1113, ATR-V0-101..107, GitHub #1109). (1) opencode reports contextDelivery UNSUPPORTED; an opencode plugin could deliver actively. (2) The Claude Code hook fires only on PostToolUse, so a session that makes no tool call after crossing a threshold never sees the notice (consider UserPromptSubmit/Stop hooks). (3) Candidate hand-offs carry no salvaged note; only attempts with dispatch: evidence get one. (4) CAL-V0-144 retention prunes old worker directories and their handoff notes. (5) The evidence directory path is fixed, not configurable.
title: dispatch context delivery gaps: opencode plugin, no-tool-call sessions, candidate hand-off notes, note retention
